prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Secure Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in to ensure your pet's progress, traits, and memory are continuously saved.", "Cloud Backup Enabled", "Sign In to Save Progress"]
1: []
2: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, minimize, and interact with your new companion anytime.", "Controls Quick Guide", "Got It"]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen or right-click for quick actions.", "Right-click your pet on desktop anytime for options."]
4: ["Use PNG or JPG files under 5MB with clear lighting for the best pet generation quality."]
5: ["Crafting Your Companion", "Initializing sprite animations and AI behaviors..."]
6: ["Sign In to Protect Your Companion", "Syncing saves your pet's memory, level, and customizations securely to the cloud.", "Cloud Auto-Sync Active"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Create an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop while you work or play.", "Get Started"]
8: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a friend with unique personality traits to accompany your daily desktop tasks."]
9: ["We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to play!"]
